nodes.instruction: Sum each department demand, subtract stock, and add reserve. Return {"units": integer}.

Normalize each supplier quote. effective_unit_cents = unit_cents - discount_cents. shipping_cents = freight_cents + handling_cents. Return {"quotes":[{"vendor":string,"unit_cents":integer,"shipping_cents":integer,"capacity":integer,"days":integer}]} for ALL suppliers. Preserve capacity and days.

Use predecessor units and quotes. total_cents = units * unit_cents + shipping_cents. A supplier is eligible iff capacity >= units AND days <= deadline_days AND total_cents <= budget_cents. Return {"options":[{"vendor":string,"total_cents":integer,"eligible":boolean}]} for ALL suppliers.
Select the eligible supplier with smallest total_cents, breaking ties alphabetically by vendor. If none is eligible, use vendor NONE and total_cents 0. Return {"vendor":string,"total_cents":integer}.
